ownership.quote: Oxylabs' company group is excited to announce the acquisition of ScrapingBee, one of the best known industry brands. ... ScrapingBee will continue operating as an independent entity, maintaining its existing leadership and brand identity.

stage.quote: The acquisition, which involved an eight-figure sum, was financed entirely from Oxylabs' company group's own resources.
stage.note: ScrapingBee was a bootstrapped, founder-owned company (co-founders Pierre de Wulf and Kevin Sahin, 'a passion project') with no VC funding rounds found; it was acquired by Oxylabs' company group in June 2025 for an undisclosed eight-figure (USD) sum funded from Oxylabs' own cash, not a priced equity round. 'acquired' is used in place of the fixed enum list since the schema has no dedicated acquisition stage; there is no evidence of any pre-seed/seed/series round ever being raised.

last_round.quote: VILNIUS, LITHUANIA / ACCESS Newswire / June 19, 2025 / Oxylabs' company group is excited to announce the acquisition of ScrapingBee... The acquisition, which involved an eight-figure sum, was financed entirely from Oxylabs' company group's own resources.

note: Founded 2019 in France by co-founders Pierre de Wulf and Kevin Sahin ('lifelong friends'), fully remote, originally launched as 'ScrapingNinja' and rebranded to ScrapingBee. Bootstrapped (no VC rounds found). Acquired by Oxylabs' company group in June 2025 for an undisclosed eight-figure USD sum, paid from Oxylabs' own cash (no outside investors in the deal). Per Oxylabs, ScrapingBee continues to operate as an independent entity under its existing leadership/brand; ScrapingBee's own blog post on the acquisition is dated 19 January 2026, i.e. the company re-published/kept the announcement live well after the June 2025 closing, and states the product still serves '20,000 users' with no price increase post-acquisition.
